top_signals.title: Vladimir Putin calls out nations opposing Russia’s return to international sports
top_signals.summary: Several countries have said their national teams will not play against Russia following a decision by sport's highest court to readmit Russian teams to international ice hockey.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
